displayName: H&M API - Prices by Country, Product Data, Stock by Size, Stores
description: H&M API for H&M prices by country - one article's price, sale price, member price and online stock by size in each H&M market, in that market's currency (article codes are the same in every market); keyword search, product detail with composition, the 10 latest reviews and fit feedback, online stock per size, stores with opening hours, category, sale and new-arrival grids, search suggestions and where an article is made. 47 countries. 9 endpoints, 1 credit each (product 2). No price history (poll), no store stock per size, no full review list.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
